headline: Trump says Saudi Arabia's nuclear deal hinges on the kingdom normalizing Israel ties
context: After a Saudi nuclear power deal raised alarm in Israel, President Trump announced online that the arrangement is subject to the kingdom normalizing relations with Israel through the Abraham Accords.

sources.name: NPR
